name: The Hollow Crown
tagline: A stolen heart-stone, a creeping blight, and the people you fall for on the road.
intro: Three months ago the Queen of Vael died in her sleep, and the heart-stone of the Ember Crown went missing from her brow the same night. Since then the Thornwake has crept south out of the frozen north: black briars that grow overnight, and the dead that walk wrapped in them. You arrive in the river town of Brightwater on a grey morning with little coin and a reason of your own to be here. The town bell is ringing, and nobody looks like they slept.

narrator.voice: Warm, grounded high fantasy with a little wit, like a well-read storyteller by a fire. Concrete senses (smell, weather, texture) over grand adjectives. Vael is a river kingdom of stone bridges, fey woods, salt ports and cold mountains; the Thornwake blight is black briar and cold silence.
narrator.romance: Romance is earnest, slow-burn and tasteful: longing looks, banter, hands held, a first kiss. Anything more fades to black.

endings.title: The Crown Restored
endings.text: The heart-stone burns again in the Ember Crown, and the Thornwake withers back into the north. Vael has a sovereign and a future, and you have a place in it.

endings.title: The Crown Shattered
endings.text: You break the crown rather than let anyone wear it. The blight dies with it, and so does the old line. Vael will have to learn to rule itself.

endings.title: The Thorn Throne
endings.text: You take the stone's power for yourself. The briars bow. The kingdom is safe, in its way, and very quiet.

endings.title: Two Hearts, One Crown
endings.text: You restore the crown with the one you love at your side, and the realm wakes to a spring nobody expected to see.

endings.title: Into the Briars
endings.text: The Thornwake takes you, as it took the Queen. Somewhere south, someone you loved keeps a candle lit.
